evidence: Moves global index singletons (`g_txindex`, `g_txospenderindex`, `g_coin_stats_index`, and block filter indexes) into `NodeContext` and introduces `src/node/indexes.{h,cpp}` to manage their lifecycle.
rationale: Moves secondary index ownership from process-global singletons into `NodeContext`, decoupling index instances from global state. This advances node encapsulation and simplifies running isolated instances in tests or multiprocess setups, but represents internal structural cleanup without direct impact on data integrity, sync performance, or user-facing behavior.
